title: 第114章 驻地自燃上第113章 主炉来信
slug: 天赋每周一刷新从变废为宝开始成仙
content_zh:
顾清寒道：
“执法堂需要一支独立留证队。”
“若我们死在炉口前，证据也要送出去。”
帐内再次安静。
这话说得太直。
但没人觉得夸张。
三宗执事互相看了一眼。
最终，鹤咏仙门执事开口：
“给。”
“但周荒，你要明白。”
“你现在已被主炉盯上。”
“你若继续拆炉，主炉会越来越针对你。”
周荒笑了笑。
“它现在也没放过我。”
玄阳宗执事看着他，忽然拱手。
“玄阳宗给你三枚玄阳破邪符。”
赤霞宗执事道：
“赤霞宗给你两瓶赤霞净血丹。”
鹤咏仙门执事则取出一枚玉牌。
“这是临时调令。”

“北冥驻地内，筑基弟子以下，凡涉及炉口行动，可由你临时调度。”
这话一出，帐内不少人神色微变。
让一个刚筑基不久的弟子临时调度三宗筑基以下？
这分量太重。
周荒没有推。
这个时候推，就是假客气。
他接过玉牌。
“好。”
“今晚休整。”
“明日拔第四口炉。”
话音刚落，帐外忽然传来一声惊呼。
“雪上有字！”
众人脸色齐变。
周荒第一个冲出主帐。
驻地中央的空地上，雪面正在慢慢变黑。
不是一个名字。
而是一行字。
“血潮前三日。”
“每日献一炉。”
“否则，驻地自燃。”

字迹落成的瞬间，驻地四角同时冒出黑红火光。
主炉开始逼他们献人了。
黑红火光从驻地四角升起时，所有人都动了。
content_en:
Gu Qinghan said:
"The Law Enforcement Hall needs an independent license retention team."
"If we die in front of the furnace mouth, the evidence will also be sent out."
The tent was quiet again.
This is too blunt to say.
But no one thought it was an exaggeration.
The three deacons looked at each other.
Finally, the deacon of Heyongxianmen spoke:
"Here."
"But Zhou Huang, you have to understand."
"You are now being targeted by the main furnace."
"If you continue to dismantle the furnace, the main furnace will target you more and more."
Zhou Huang smiled.
"It doesn't let me go now."
The deacon of Xuanyang Sect looked at him and suddenly raised his hand.
"The Xuanyang Sect gives you three Xuanyang Evil-Breaking Talismans."
The deacon of Chixia Sect said:
"The Chixia Sect will give you two bottles of Chixia Blood Purifying Pills."
The deacon of Heyong Xianmen took out a jade tablet.
"This is a temporary transfer order."
"In Beiming Station, any action involving the furnace mouth, below the foundation disciples, can be temporarily dispatched by you."
As soon as these words came out, the expressions of many people in the tent changed slightly.
Let a disciple who has just established a foundation to temporarily dispatch three sects to establish a foundation?
This weight is too heavy.
Zhou Huang didn't push.
To push at this time is to be falsely polite.
He took the jade token.
"Okay."
"Relax tonight."
"Pull out the fourth stove tomorrow."
As soon as he finished speaking, an exclamation suddenly came from outside the tent.
"There is writing on the snow!"
Everyone's expressions changed.
Zhou Huang was the first to rush out of the main tent.
In the open space in the center of the station, the snow surface is slowly turning black.
Not a name.
But a line of words.
"Three days before the blood tide."
"Dedicate a furnace every day."
"Otherwise, the station will spontaneously combust."
The moment the handwriting was completed, black and red flames erupted from all four corners of the station.
The main furnace began to force them to sacrifice people.
Everyone moved when black and red flames rose from the four corners of the station.
